title: I finally made something I enjoy playing. Now I’m nervous about showing it to other people.
author: AsnIsCrazyToo
selftext:
I’ve been working on this little game where you build a plane out of parts you find, then take it into combat.

For a while, it worked, but I wasn’t really enjoying it. Recently I changed the controls so you move with WASD and aim with the mouse, and gave the weapons more distinct roles. It finally started to feel like something I actually wanted to keep playing.

So I recorded a bit of it.

It’s still an early prototype, and I honestly have no idea whether the fun comes across in a video—or whether I just like it because I made it 😅

What’s your first impression?

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body: Nice, kind of like the old Asteroids.

comments.author: w00tlez
comments.body:
Your movement is very stiff. E.g. like an 80s arcade. Personally I think a bit of drift would make it better. Like when you let go of W or S, you slow down and move a few pixels instead of coming to an abrupt stop. Also, when you aim, the ship should have a turning speed, instead of just pointing straight to the mouse pointer. 

That's just my opinion

replies.author: AsnIsCrazyToo
replies.body: very usefull advice for me .I will modiy , maybe I will add some particles that changed by plane moving

comments.author: askdoobie
comments.body: The gameplay does not look fun maybe make it more tower defence like so that enemies come from a specific direction and then add buildings one can build for defence, with every wave of enemies you unlock a piece of more land and unlock more building.

replies.author: AsnIsCrazyToo
replies.body: thanks , yes tower defence is another direction. Maybe I should think about to make a new demo...
